# dsh-moodboard
English · 中文

A **visual reference moodboard** for DeepSeek Harness. Collect screenshots and
inspiration images in

the Web UI, tag and annotate them, pin the ones that
define your app's visual language, and let the

agent read that style guide
before it generates or restyles UI.

The panel is the **Warm Sand Studio** interface: a warm sand canvas, white
cards, one coral accent,

deep warm ink, soft 18–22px radii and pill controls.
It is built from the Harness theme tokens, so l

ight and dark follow the host.
See docs/UI-REDESIGN.md.
## Preview
A quick tour after installation:

1. Open **Moodboard** from the sidebar. The header shows the image and pinned
counts, **Add images**

, **Add from link**, **Paste image**, **Copy agent
brief**, shortcut help and the quiet suite star l

ink.
2. Add references by dragging files anywhere on the page, pasting with
⌘V/Ctrl+V, picking files

with **Add images**, or opening **Add references**
to paste links or search Mobbin/Are.na. Add tags

and turn on **Pin imported
references** there.
3. Select a card to open the inspector. Edit its nam

e, tags, notes and source
URL, copy/paste metadata onto another reference, or pin it with the **Styl

e
guide** switch. **Manage** moves, replaces or removes it.
4. Use the search box and tag chips, ope

n a reference in the lightbox, or
Cmd/Shift-click several cards for the bulk bar. Press `?` for shor

tcuts.
5. Insert the reference directive with the composer's **Moodboard** button, or
copy a ready-m
ade agent brief from the header.

## What's new in 0.4

- **Warm Sand Studio redesign.** Warm sand canvas, white cards, one coral
accent for primary actions

, pins and active filters, deep warm ink, 18px
cards / 22px dialogs / 12px inputs, pill buttons and

chips, and soft warm
shadows. Light and dark both derive from the host tokens.
- **Redesigned Add re

ferences dialog.** Gradient header, segmented **From links**
/ **Discover** tabs, live `n / 20` link

counter, a real pin setting row with an
explanation, and a sticky footer with the coral primary on

the right.
- **Redesigned reference inspector.** Kicker row with a solid **Style guide**
pill, 16:10

preview, section labels with trailing rules, grouped move pair,
borderless remove, and a sticky foo

ter whose disabled Save reads as inactive.
- **Responsive and verified.** The inspector becomes a bo

ttom sheet on narrow
screens; a real-render harness captures the live `client.js` in light and
dark
across page, dialog, inspector, lightbox, bulk bar and phone widths.
Full history: CHANGELOG.md.
## What you get

- **Moodboard panel** in the Web UI (sidebar icon) with a coral mark, title,
image/pinned count pill

s, and one row of actions: **Add images**, **Add from
link**, **Paste image**, **Copy agent brief**,

keyboard-shortcut help and the
quiet suite star link.
- **Warm Sand Studio styling** built from `--

dsw-alias-*` through a local
`--mb-*` layer: a warm canvas, card surfaces, hairline warm borders, on

e
coral accent, warm ink, 4px-based spacing and soft shadows. Motion honours
`prefers-reduced-motion

`; focus rings, live regions and labelled controls are
preserved.
- **Active style guide hero**: pin

ned thumbnails, a pinned count and the “The
agent reads these images before designing UI” reminder.

Click a thumbnail for
the lightbox, unpin in place, and see each reference's top tags.
- **Gallery**

: search across name, tags, notes and source; tag chips with
counts in the same sticky toolbar; drag

-to-reorder; **Select all**; lazy,
paged thumbnails; card hover actions for expand, pin, replace and

solid **Style guide** pill when
pinned, a 16:10 preview, and grouped **Details** (name, tags, notes

, source
URL), **Metadata** (copy/paste tags, notes and source), **Style guide** (the
pin switch and

what the agent does with it) and **Manage** (move pair,
replace, borderless remove with inline conf

irm). The sticky footer shows
saved/unsaved status with Cancel and Save.
- **Add references dialog**

: **From links** / **Discover** tabs, a live
`n / 20 links` counter, tag editor, pin setting row, an

d a sticky footer with
Close plus the coral primary. Discover has source, query, platform and result

s
fields with the Mobbin key hint; results report added / already-on-board /
failed counts and offer

**Copy workflow**.
- **Capture**: drag-and-drop image files, clipboard paste with ⌘V/Ctrl+V, the
**

Paste image** and **Add images** buttons, Open Graph/Twitter link previews,
Mobbin and Are.na discov

ery, and local screenshot paths from a browser MCP
through the agent tool.
- **Organize**: drag card

s to set the gallery order; Shift/Cmd-click to select

## Pull inspiration automatically

The panel's **Add from link** button opens the **Add references** dialog, which
has two intakes:

- **From links** — paste up to 20 public page URLs. The Host fetches each page
and stores its Open G

raph/Twitter preview image with the title, author, site,
description and canonical source URL. Direc

t image URLs work too.
- **Discover** — search **Mobbin** screens (official REST API, Team/Enterpris

e
key) or **Are.na** (public, no key) and add the results in one action. Mobbin
[该节后续省略]

DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0` with the Web profile (the Host half
needs `attachments`, `t

ools`, `systemPrompt`, `webServer`, and `connection`;
the browser half needs the slots and locale se

systemPrompt`, `webServer`, and `connection`;
the browser half needs the slots and locale services).
